# Anthropic request goldens

Generated by `tools/golden/gen_anthropic.py` (`just golden`) from the frozen Python app at commit
`cfd9dc1e9a5e653a48863c7e71370ba2ea1aac40`. Do not edit by hand; regenerate only when the Python source gets a fix, and commit the result.

Each `<scenario>.json` holds `exchanges`: the HTTP request the Python anthropic SDK (version 1.6.0) sends
(`method`, `path`, `query`, the `anthropic-beta`/`anthropic-version`/`content-type` headers and the parsed JSON
`body`) and the scripted response the loop received (tests/fake_anthropic.py shape). `runs` and `usage` are the
rows the run left in the `runs` and `usage` tables. Compare bodies with canonical-JSON equality
(`internal/testutil/golden`), never byte equality: key order, HTML escaping and number formatting differ
between the SDKs.

`prompt_stability.json` lists, per run kind, the system block order with each block's cache_control, the tool
order and its breakpoint, and the full text of every system block and tool definition. The generator builds every
kind twice in separate instances at different dates, thread ids and operator text and fails unless the cached
prefix (system through its last breakpoint, plus all tools) is identical and free of the date stamp.

Excluded (not ported in Phase A): tool `run_code`; code_execution tool and container (thread code sandbox); container_upload blocks; Files API upload and delete; notion_migrate json_schema output_config.format.

Known divergences for the Go port (also in `manifest.json` under `divergences`):
- prompts.SYSTEM (system[0].text of every request here): tells the model to call run_code for several read-only lookups; run_code is not ported in Phase A and is absent from every tools list here; the Go prompt slice (https://github.com/jeiang/atrium/issues/125) decides how to handle the text; until it does, a Go body may differ from these goldens at system[0].text only by the run_code sentence.
- files.SANDBOX_PROMPT (sent only with the thread code sandbox on, so in no golden here): names run_code as a separate interpreter; the code sandbox and run_code are both not ported in Phase A; the Go prompt slice (https://github.com/jeiang/atrium/issues/125).
